host_boundaries: Pen/model input arrays and IContext/canvas/resource/queue are explicit synthetic host inputs; native Model getters, ObjectDrawing route, AirBrushPen factory/admission, MotionEvent getter path, AirBrush GLV1/GLV2 geometry and RTV1 AddPoint execute in the pinned native DSOs.

The IContext, canvases, bitmap/resource objects, and IGLMsgQueue are synthetic host objects. Queue registration and post are synchronous adapters that invoke each task vslot+16; task Run methods themselves execute natively. sincosf and expf use Python math callbacks with captured f32 input/output; target libm math execution is not claimed. malloc/new allocate in the emulator arena and free is a no-op, so target allocator/lifetime behavior is not claimed. Renderer/GLES callbacks and pixel rendering are outside this capture.

The explicit-empty case constructs an empty native String and calls ObjectStroke::SetAdvancedPenSetting; the unset case omits that call and the getter is null. These are synthetic Model setter inputs, not SDK-deserialized app strokes or user-captured data.
